data.name: Loudness:TargetLufs.Label
data.value: Loudness target

data.name: Loudness:TargetLufs.Help
data.value: The loudness target the mix is normalized toward, in LUFS — every track is gained to match it before crossfading.

data.name: Loudness:CeilingDbtp.Label
data.value: Peak limit (true peak)

data.name: Loudness:CeilingDbtp.Help
data.value: The true-peak ceiling the mix must not exceed, in dBTP — guards against inter-sample clipping downstream.

data.name: Station:Name.Label
data.value: Station name

data.name: Station:Name.Help
data.value: The public Icecast stream/directory name updates on the next engine restart; patter, metadata, and this console update immediately.

data.name: Station:Tagline.Label
data.value: Station tagline

data.name: Station:Tagline.Help
data.value: A short line shown under the station name on the About page. Optional — leave blank to show no tagline. Up to 120 characters.

data.name: Station:Voice.Label
data.value: Station voice

data.name: Station:Voice.Help
data.value: The Kokoro voice used for station-branded patter (station IDs, time/date, lead-ins, back-announces) whenever no persona is active.

data.name: Station:Cadence:LeadInBeforeEachTrack.Label
data.value: Spoken intro before each track

data.name: Station:Cadence:LeadInBeforeEachTrack.Help
data.value: When on, a short spoken lead-in airs immediately before each track begins.

data.name: Station:Cadence:BackAnnounceAfterEachTrack.Label
data.value: Name each song after it plays

data.name: Station:Cadence:BackAnnounceAfterEachTrack.Help
data.value: When on, a short spoken back-announce airs immediately after each track ends.

data.name: Station:Cadence:StationIdEveryNUnits.Label
data.value: Station name frequency (station ID)

data.name: Station:Cadence:StationIdEveryNUnits.Help
data.value: Set to 0 to turn station IDs off entirely — no station ID ever airs.

data.name: Station:Scope:LibraryIds.Label
data.value: Main rotation libraries

data.name: Station:Scope:LibraryIds.Help
data.value: The libraries the main rotation picks tracks from — must name at least one library, or the station has nothing to play.

data.name: Station:SafeScope:LibraryIds.Label
data.value: Station sounds libraries

data.name: Station:SafeScope:LibraryIds.Help
data.value: The libraries holding Station sounds — the always-airable station segments (IDs, jingles, sweepers, liners) played when the main rotation drains. An empty list is legal and falls back to silence (mksafe).

data.name: Station:Rotation:RecentWindow.Label
data.value: Anti-repeat window

data.name: Station:Rotation:RecentWindow.Help
data.value: How many recently-played tracks the rotation avoids repeating. 0 disables anti-repeat entirely.

data.name: Station:Rotation:ArtistSeparation.Label
data.value: Artist separation

data.name: Station:Rotation:ArtistSeparation.Help
data.value: How many of the recent tracks must pass before the same artist can repeat. Separation is limited by the anti-repeat window above — it reads the same recent-tracks window, so a value deeper than that window has no additional effect, and an anti-repeat window of 0 disables artist separation too.

data.name: Station:Envelope:Genres.Label
data.value: Allowed genres

data.name: Station:Envelope:Genres.Help
data.value: The genre allow-list the station's single 24/7 envelope admits — a track outside this list never enters rotation. A JSON array of genre names; empty means every genre is allowed.

data.name: Station:Envelope:EnergyMin.Label
data.value: Minimum energy

data.name: Station:Envelope:EnergyMin.Help
data.value: The lowest energy percentile the envelope admits (0 = the least energetic ready track in the library).

data.name: Station:Envelope:EnergyMax.Label
data.value: Maximum energy

data.name: Station:Envelope:EnergyMax.Help
data.value: The highest energy percentile the envelope admits (1 = the most energetic ready track in the library).

data.name: Station:SpectatorMode.Label
data.value: Spectator mode

data.name: Station:SpectatorMode.Help
data.value: Public read-only spectator page and API. Off by default; when on, /spectator serves without login.

data.name: Station:PublicStreamUrl.Label
data.value: Public stream URL

data.name: Station:PublicStreamUrl.Help
data.value: Public stream URL for the spectator page player (e.g. /stream behind the reference proxy). Empty hides the player.

data.name: Station:PublicBaseUrl.Label
data.value: Public base URL

data.name: Station:PublicBaseUrl.Help
data.value: Public base URL feeder pushes resolve per-track artwork and station-icon URLs against (e.g. https://your-station.example). Empty means no artwork URL is ever sent to listening clients.

data.name: Station:Requests:Enabled.Label
data.value: Listener requests

data.name: Station:Requests:Enabled.Help
data.value: Public listener request line. Off by default; when off, the request endpoint 404s like any other disabled surface.

data.name: Station:Requests:OverrideEnvelope.Label
data.value: Requests skip genre and energy limits

data.name: Station:Requests:OverrideEnvelope.Help
data.value: When on, a matched request bypasses the envelope's genre/energy band and rotation-recency to air sooner — operator never-play/eligibility vetoes still apply either way.

data.name: Station:Requests:WindowMinutes.Label
data.value: Request expiry window

data.name: Station:Requests:WindowMinutes.Help
data.value: How long an unfulfilled request stays eligible to air before it expires.

data.name: Station:Thumbs:Enabled.Label
data.value: Listener thumbs

data.name: Station:Thumbs:Enabled.Help
data.value: Anonymous thumbs up/down on the spectator now-playing card; off means the thumbs endpoint and controls do not exist (404).

data.name: Tts:Endpoint.Label
data.value: Speech service URL (TTS)

data.name: Tts:Endpoint.Help
data.value: The Kokoro TTS service base URL used to render all spoken patter — must be a non-empty absolute http/https URL; there is no "disabled TTS" state.

data.name: Tts:Corrections.Label
data.value: Pronunciation corrections

data.name: Tts:Corrections.Help
data.value: Operator pronunciation corrections applied to every spoken line before it reaches the TTS engine (e.g. "MacLeod" to "Muh-cloud"). Each rule can carry optional context conditions for heteronyms — "wind" to "wynd" only when followed by "down" or "up" — so the other sense ("a strong wind") stays untouched. Empty means no corrections.

data.name: Tts:Pronunciations.Label
data.value: Station pronunciation rules

data.name: Tts:Pronunciations.Help
data.value: Station pronunciation rules the Kokoro voice engine honors directly (IPA phoneme overrides, e.g. pattern "Reykjavík" to ipa "/ˈreɪkjaviːk/") rather than text substitutions. A rule's optional word narrows which occurrence of a longer pattern gets the override, disambiguating heteronyms like "wind". The active persona's own rules win when both name the same pattern/word. Empty means no station pronunciation rules.

data.name: Tts:Fallback:Endpoint.Label
data.value: Backup speech service URL

data.name: Tts:Fallback:Endpoint.Help
data.value: The Piper local fallback TTS service base URL — hop 1 of the fallback chain, used automatically when Kokoro is unhealthy or a render fails. Leave empty to disable the fallback engine entirely. Ignored when the deployment configures a fallback profile chain, which replaces this single hop with an operator-built list of fallback engines.

data.name: Tts:Fallback:Voice.Label
data.value: Backup speech voice

data.name: Tts:Fallback:Voice.Help
data.value: The Piper voice model the fallback service is expected to be running — display-only: Piper bakes one voice into the sidecar and has no per-request selector, so this is never sent with a render; it only documents what compose deployed. In a fallback profile chain each hop carries its own voice instead — honored on the wire for Kokoro-kind hops, display-only for Piper hops.

data.name: Tts:EngineByKind.Label
data.value: Engine by speech kind

data.name: Tts:EngineByKind.Help
data.value: Pins specific speech kinds to a specific engine, e.g. StationId to Piper so a short ident always uses the cheap voice. Add one override row per kind (StationId, LeadIn, BackAnnounce, TimeDate, SignOff, SignOn); kinds without an override use the normal Kokoro-first, Piper-fallback routing.

data.name: Llm:Endpoint.Label
data.value: AI writer URL (LLM)

data.name: Llm:Endpoint.Help
data.value: The LLM completion service base URL used to author patter copy — leave empty to disable LLM-authored copy and fall back to templated copy.

data.name: Llm:Model.Label
data.value: AI writer model

data.name: Llm:Model.Help
data.value: The model the AI writer uses, picked from the list the LLM endpoint serves. Used only when that endpoint is set.

data.name: Llm:TimeoutSeconds.Label
data.value: AI writer time limit

data.name: Llm:TimeoutSeconds.Help
data.value: How long an LLM completion request is allowed to run before falling back to templated copy.

data.name: Tts:RenderBudgetSeconds.Label
data.value: Speech render time limit

data.name: Tts:RenderBudgetSeconds.Help
data.value: How long a single TTS render is allowed to take before it is abandoned.

data.name: Tts:BlurbRetentionHours.Label
data.value: Speech clip cache lifetime

data.name: Tts:BlurbRetentionHours.Help
data.value: How long a rendered TTS blurb stays cached before the garbage-collection sweep removes it.

data.name: Llm:MaxCopyChars.Label
data.value: Longest written DJ line

data.name: Llm:MaxCopyChars.Help
data.value: The maximum length, in characters, of LLM-authored patter copy — longer completions are truncated.

data.name: Admin:PlayHistoryCapacity.Label
data.value: Play history capacity

data.name: Admin:PlayHistoryCapacity.Help
data.value: How many recent plays the play-history ring keeps before the oldest entry is dropped.

data.name: Library:ScanIntervalSeconds.Label
data.value: Library scan interval

data.name: Library:ScanIntervalSeconds.Help
data.value: How often the library scans for new or changed files, in seconds.

data.name: Library:EnrichmentConcurrency.Label
data.value: Tracks analyzed at once

data.name: Library:EnrichmentConcurrency.Help
data.value: How many tracks are analyzed (loudness, cue points, energy, tags) in parallel during enrichment.

data.name: Library:Scan:MissThreshold.Label
data.value: Scan miss threshold

data.name: Library:Scan:MissThreshold.Help
data.value: How many consecutive scan ticks a file may be missing from the library folder before it is marked unavailable — a higher value rides out a brief NFS/mount blip without pulling a track from rotation.

data.name: Library:YearLookup:Enabled.Label
data.value: Year lookup

data.name: Library:YearLookup:Enabled.Help
data.value: When on, tracks missing a release year get one looked up from MusicBrainz during enrichment. Turning it off stops future lookups; years already filled stay.

data.name: Library:YearLookup:Endpoint.Label
data.value: Year lookup endpoint

data.name: Library:YearLookup:Endpoint.Help
data.value: The MusicBrainz web service base URL used to look up a missing release year — must be a non-empty absolute http/https URL.

data.name: Library:YearLookup:MinScore.Label
data.value: Year lookup confidence

data.name: Library:YearLookup:MinScore.Help
data.value: The minimum MusicBrainz match confidence a candidate must reach before its year is accepted.

data.name: GW_XFADE_MIN.Label
data.value: Shortest song overlap (crossfade)

data.name: GW_XFADE_MIN.Help
data.value: The shortest crossfade duration the engine uses between tracks, in seconds.

data.name: GW_XFADE_MAX.Label
data.value: Longest song overlap

data.name: GW_XFADE_MAX.Help
data.value: The longest crossfade duration the engine uses between tracks, in seconds.

data.name: GW_SAFE_GAP_SECONDS.Label
data.value: Station sounds gap

data.name: GW_SAFE_GAP_SECONDS.Help
data.value: The silence gap the engine inserts between consecutive Station sounds (safe-rotation) tracks, in seconds. 0 disables the gap.

data.name: Library:CueDetection:MinSilenceDurationSec.Label
data.value: Shortest silence to trim

data.name: Library:CueDetection:MinSilenceDurationSec.Help
data.value: The shortest silent region, in seconds, that counts as a cue point during trim detection. Applies the next time a file is (re-)analyzed.

data.name: Library:Energy:WindowSeconds.Label
data.value: Energy analysis window

data.name: Library:Energy:WindowSeconds.Help
data.value: The length of the intro/outro window measured for energy analysis, in seconds. Applies the next time a file is (re-)analyzed.

data.name: DependencyHealth:ProbeIntervalSeconds.Label
data.value: Health probe interval

data.name: DependencyHealth:ProbeIntervalSeconds.Help
data.value: How often the station checks that Kokoro, Piper, Ollama and Icecast are still answering, in seconds. Applies to the next check — no restart.

data.name: DependencyHealth:ProbeTimeoutSeconds.Label
data.value: Health probe timeout

data.name: DependencyHealth:ProbeTimeoutSeconds.Help
data.value: How long one health check waits for an answer before counting as a failure, in seconds. Kokoro stops answering while it renders a clip, so a budget shorter than a typical render reports it down when it is merely busy.

data.name: DependencyHealth:UnhealthyThreshold.Label
data.value: Unhealthy threshold

data.name: DependencyHealth:UnhealthyThreshold.Help
data.value: How many checks in a row must fail before the station treats a service as down and starts using its fallback. 1 reacts fastest but flips on a single missed check; the default 2 ignores one-off blips. Higher values mean a genuinely dead service goes unnoticed for this many checks.

data.name: Llm:DegradationPin.Label
data.value: AI writer fallback mode

data.name: Llm:DegradationPin.Help
data.value: Pins the LLM degradation mode instead of letting it auto-adjust to failures/recoveries. "auto" (default) follows automatically; "normal", "soft", or "hard" holds that mode until this is set back to "auto".

data.name: Llm:ReasoningEffort.Label
data.value: AI writer thinking effort

data.name: Llm:ReasoningEffort.Help
data.value: How much a thinking-capable model (gemma4, qwen3, deepseek-r1, magistral) may think before it answers. "None" (default) makes it answer directly — otherwise its chain-of-thought spends the whole copy budget and every line comes back empty. "Low"/"Medium"/"High" let it think, at the cost of time. "Omit" sends no reasoning field at all, for a third-party OpenAI-compatible backend that rejects it. Ordinary models ignore this. Changes apply live.

data.name: Choice.Llm:ReasoningEffort.none
data.value: None — answer directly (thinking models skip their chain-of-thought)

data.name: Choice.Llm:ReasoningEffort.low
data.value: Low — think briefly first

data.name: Choice.Llm:ReasoningEffort.medium
data.value: Medium — think before answering

data.name: Choice.Llm:ReasoningEffort.high
data.value: High — think at length (slow; needs a generous response timeout)

data.name: Choice.Llm:ReasoningEffort.omit
data.value: Omit — send no reasoning field (for a backend that rejects it)

data.name: Choice.NotFound
data.value: {0} (not found)

data.name: Community:CatalogIndexUrl.Label
data.value: Persona catalog URL

data.name: Community:CatalogIndexUrl.Help
data.value: Where the Persona Catalog browses and imports personas from. Leave empty to disable the Persona Catalog entirely — both catalog endpoints stop responding and this admin UI hides the shelf. Changes apply live.

data.name: Station:Audience.Label
data.value: Explicit content

data.name: Station:Audience.Help
data.value: Everyone ("everyone", the default) keeps every track stamped explicit out of the pool entirely — it never plays, displays, or reaches the DJ's mouth. Mature ("mature") plays everything, unmasked. Changes apply live.

data.name: Station:Timezone.Label
data.value: Station timezone

data.name: Station:Timezone.Help
data.value: The IANA timezone the DJ's spoken date/time follows (e.g. America/Edmonton). Empty uses the container's own clock. Changes apply live. The schedule grid and persona taste gates follow it too, so changing it immediately shifts which slot is on the air.

data.name: Station:Theme.Label
data.value: Station theme

data.name: Station:Theme.Help
data.value: The station's active theme, by slug (e.g. cats-whisker) — must name one of the shipped themes; an unrecognized slug is rejected outright rather than silently failing to resolve. Changes apply live.

data.name: Station:IconPack.Label
data.value: Icon pack

data.name: Station:IconPack.Help
data.value: The station's active icon pack, by slug — fed by the packs installed on the Community Catalog. Empty (the default) uses the house icons. Uninstalling the active pack leaves this value dangling; the admin chrome falls back to house icons rather than erroring. Changes apply live.

data.name: Context:Weather:Enabled.Label
data.value: Weather segments

data.name: Context:Weather:Enabled.Help
data.value: Airs a weather segment/patter line sourced from Open-Meteo. Off by default; also requires the station's broadcast location (latitude and longitude) — blank or invalid coordinates leave weather off even when this is on.

data.name: Context:Weather:SegmentCadenceMinutes.Label
data.value: Weather segment cadence

data.name: Context:Weather:SegmentCadenceMinutes.Help
data.value: How often a fresh weather segment may air, in minutes.

data.name: Context:Weather:PatterCadenceMinutes.Label
data.value: Weather mentions in DJ chat

data.name: Context:Weather:PatterCadenceMinutes.Help
data.value: How often a compact weather line may be folded into patter, in minutes — independent of the segment cadence above. 0 disables weather patter lines.

data.name: Context:Weather:PersonaId.Label
data.value: Weather persona

data.name: Context:Weather:PersonaId.Help
data.value: Which persona voices weather segments. 0 defers to the on-air DJ (the unset default does the same).

data.name: Context:History:Enabled.Label
data.value: History segments

data.name: Context:History:Enabled.Help
data.value: Airs a this-day-in-history segment/patter line sourced from Wikimedia's On This Day feed. Off by default.

data.name: Context:History:SegmentCadenceMinutes.Label
data.value: History segment cadence

data.name: Context:History:SegmentCadenceMinutes.Help
data.value: How often a fresh history segment may air, in minutes.

data.name: Context:History:PatterCadenceMinutes.Label
data.value: History mentions in DJ chat

data.name: Context:History:PatterCadenceMinutes.Help
data.value: How often a compact history line may be folded into patter, in minutes — independent of the segment cadence above. 0 disables history patter lines.

data.name: Context:History:PersonaId.Label
data.value: History persona

data.name: Context:History:PersonaId.Help
data.value: Which persona voices history segments. 0 defers to the on-air DJ (the unset default does the same).

data.name: Station:Location:Latitude.Label
data.value: Station latitude

data.name: Station:Location:Latitude.Help
data.value: Signed decimal degrees only (negative = south), with a period as the decimal separator — e.g. 51.0447 or -33.8688. Accepted range: -90 to 90; only the first 4 decimal places are used. Degrees-minutes-seconds and degrees-decimal-minutes formats are not accepted. Used only to fetch weather — never spoken or logged. Blank behaves exactly like an invalid value: weather stays silently off.

data.name: Station:Location:Longitude.Label
data.value: Station longitude

data.name: Station:Location:Longitude.Help
data.value: Signed decimal degrees only (negative = west), with a period as the decimal separator — e.g. -114.0719 or 151.2093. Accepted range: -180 to 180; only the first 4 decimal places are used. Degrees-minutes-seconds and degrees-decimal-minutes formats are not accepted. Used only to fetch weather — never spoken or logged. Blank behaves exactly like an invalid value: weather stays silently off.

data.name: Station:Location:SpokenName.Label
data.value: Spoken location name

data.name: Station:Location:SpokenName.Help
data.value: The only location text ever spoken or logged, e.g. "Calgary" — coordinates themselves never air. Blank means weather segments name no place at all.

data.name: Station:Imaging:ClockAnchoredIdents.Label
data.value: Station name at the top of the hour

data.name: Station:Imaging:ClockAnchoredIdents.Help
data.value: When on, a station ID airs at the top of every hour in addition to the regular cadence count. Off by default.

data.name: Station:Imaging:TimeAnnouncements.Label
data.value: Top-of-hour time announcement

data.name: Station:Imaging:TimeAnnouncements.Help
data.value: When on, a spoken time announcement airs at the top of every hour. Off by default.

data.name: Station:Imaging:TimeAnnouncementBudgetSeconds.Label
data.value: Time announcement budget

data.name: Station:Imaging:TimeAnnouncementBudgetSeconds.Help
data.value: A time announcement that drains more than this many seconds late (accounting for whatever is already queued ahead of it) is dropped instead of airing a stale hour — a late ident is fine, a late time check is not. Within the budget but more than 90 seconds late, the announcement airs an honest "just past" variant instead of staying silent. Defaults to 420.

data.name: Station:Shows:PatterCadenceMinutes.Label
data.value: Show theme mentions in DJ chat

data.name: Station:Shows:PatterCadenceMinutes.Help
data.value: How often a show's flavor may color an ordinary lead-in/back-announce, in minutes — shares the same one-line slot as the context patter lines above; a due context fact always wins. 0 disables the show-flavor line.

data.name: Crosstalk:DurationTargetSeconds.Label
data.value: Two-host banter length limit

data.name: Crosstalk:DurationTargetSeconds.Help
data.value: The longest a generated two-voice banter exchange may run, in seconds, before it is discarded and skipped rather than aired. Defaults to 50.

data.name: Crosstalk:Shows.Label
data.value: Shows with two-host banter (crosstalk)

data.name: Crosstalk:Shows.Help
data.value: The shows allowed to carry two-voice banter. None ticked (the default) turns the feature off — no station's sound changes on upgrade until a show is ticked here.

data.name: Crosstalk:EveryNthAiring.Label
data.value: Two-host banter frequency

data.name: Crosstalk:EveryNthAiring.Help
data.value: How many eligible airings of an enabled show pass before one carries banter — 1 (the default) airs every time.

data.name: Station:Ads:EveryNUnits.Label
data.value: Ad frequency

data.name: Station:Ads:EveryNUnits.Help
data.value: A ready ad spot airs every N units, the same cadence shape as the station-ID count above — 0 (the default) disables ad spots entirely.

data.name: Station:Ads:TargetCount.Label
data.value: Ad stock target

data.name: Station:Ads:TargetCount.Help
data.value: How many generated spots the ad-spot worker keeps in the pipeline — draft, approved, rendering, or ready — refilling as spots retire or are discarded. Your own spots never count. Defaults to 12.

data.name: Station:Ads:RefreshDays.Label
data.value: Ad refresh interval

data.name: Station:Ads:RefreshDays.Help
data.value: A ready spot older than this many days is retired and the stock refills — keeps ad copy from going stale. Defaults to 30.

data.name: Station:Ads:AutoApprove.Label
data.value: Auto-approve ads

data.name: Station:Ads:AutoApprove.Help
data.value: When off (the default), a freshly generated spot waits in draft for the owner's approval before it can ever air. When on, generation flows straight to approved.

data.name: Station:Ads:AntiRepeatWindow.Label
data.value: Ad sponsor anti-repeat

data.name: Station:Ads:AntiRepeatWindow.Help
data.value: How many of the most recently aired sponsors are excluded from the next ad pick, so the same sponsor does not come back to back. Defaults to 5.

data.name: Station:Ads:AnnouncerVoice.Label
data.value: Ad announcer voice

data.name: Station:Ads:AnnouncerVoice.Help
data.value: The Kokoro voice cast as an ad's announcer. Empty (the default) uses the station's own voice instead of a separate one. Accepted value: empty, or a single voice id (e.g. af_nova).

data.name: Station:Ads:CastVoices.Label
data.value: Ad cast voice pool

data.name: Station:Ads:CastVoices.Help
data.value: The pool of Kokoro voices an ad may cast for its other speaking roles, as a comma-separated list of voice ids with no spaces, up to 16 ids. Defaults to af_nova,am_michael,bf_alice,am_onyx.

data.name: Station:Ads:BedFadeMs.Label
data.value: Ad background music fade-out

data.name: Station:Ads:BedFadeMs.Help
data.value: How long the background music takes to fade out at the end of a generated ad, as the voice ends, in milliseconds. Defaults to 300.

data.name: Station:Ads:BedDuckDb.Label
data.value: Music under the voice in ads

data.name: Station:Ads:BedDuckDb.Help
data.value: How far below the voice the background music sits in a generated ad, in decibels, measured against the voice so the number means the same whatever the music's own level. Defaults to -12. 0 means no ducking at all, -60 is effectively silent. Changing it makes existing previews out of date until they are rendered again.
